svg.title: Scriptorium decorative initial M
svg.desc: Modified Royal Initialen artwork; Illuminated penwork versals with historic blackletter anatomy, newly incised stem scrolls and extensive open curling pen sprays. Transparent currentColor paths. Modified-work details: metadata.json. LPPL 1.3c or later. Complete original collection: https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/initials.zip.
